findings.location: Article paragraph on preaching; quote from Romans 1:14–15
findings.source_quote: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the quoted wording with a faithful Indonesian translation that preserves the distinction: “Aku berutang kepada orang Yunani maupun orang barbar, kepada orang bijak maupun orang bodoh.” Keep the reference as Roma 1:14-15.
findings.translation_quote: Aku berutang kepada orang Yunani maupun orang bukan Yunani, kepada orang bijak maupun orang bodoh.
